blurb: Beanie's Marina is located in Lakeland, MN on the St. Croix River and offers pontoon boat rentals, boat launch access, and water toy rentals. Rentals are open from June through September, and the boat launch operates all year. Water inflatables and tow-behind tubes are available for additional fun. Snacks, drinks, and ice are available for purchase at the marina.
extraNote: No season passes available for boat launch · June - September for rentals; launch open every day of the year
